alex_sales: Maya from NorthBridge wants a 90-day pilot: streaming + function calls that return strict JSON per-tenant. They need: SAML SSO, KMS/BYOK, a short infra runbook, and a pricing ballpark (peak 50 rps, avg 10 rps, ~5M tokens/day). Can SE list blockers?
maya_cust: Also require sample SDK for websocket streaming + function call loop. Low ops overhead preferred.
priya_se: Quick plan: Hosted demo first (fast), Dedicated if they want isolation. Checklist: 1) SAML metadata, 2) KMS intent (BYOK or Redwood-managed), 3) JSON schemas for functions, 4) target p95 latency.
priya_se: Small SDK snippet (py) we'll hand off, plus a tiny test harness to validate structured_output against schema.
noor_prod: Security summary: TLS 1.3, AES-256 at rest, option for customer KMS on Private. Will attach SOC2 summary and questionnaire answers.
gabe_infra: Handshake/runbook (ephemeral tokens):
1) Auth bridge returns token TTL=1h.
2) Client connects: wscat -c "wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1?token=<EPHEM>"
3) Rotate every 45m by reconnecting with new token. Avoid in-stream token swap.
sec_bot: Security doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sq/northbridge-1751239876 (sales+sec only) :lock:
priya_se: Pricing note for sales: I'll propose Hosted pilot blended cap and a Dedicated trial commit; will post numbers in the sales playbook.
alex_sales: Actions: Priya send SDK sample + test harness by EOD; Noor attach security artifacts; Gabe post runbook; Maya to share SAML metadata. Demo tentatively Thu 10am PT.
maya_cust: Thu 10am PT works, sending SAML metadata now. Thanks!
